claim: Smyth tasting menu $420/person, 20-acre farm south of Chicago; all 2-star restaurant descriptions and prices
quote: Elevated tasting menus upstairs and one of the city's best burgers in the dark, sultry basement. Daily-changing menus feature seasonal produce from a 20-acre farm south of the city.

claim: 2025 Michelin Guide ceremony: Kasama promoted to 2 stars; Chicago has 4 two-star restaurants total (Alinea, Kasama, Ever, Oriole)
quote: Kasama, formerly a One Star, has joined the ranks of the Two Stars

claim: Smyth ranked #1 on North America's 50 Best Restaurants 2026; Chicago's only three-star Michelin restaurant
quote: Smyth, at 177 N. Ada St. #101 in the West Loop, landed at No. 1. The 10-year-old, farm-to-table restaurant, known for its elaborate tasting menu, pairings and natural wines is also Chicago's only three-star Michelin rated spot

claim: Historical star timeline: Smyth (1★ 2017, 3★ 2023); Oriole (2★ since 2017); Alinea (3★ 2011–2025, 2★ Nov 2025); Ever (2★ since 2021)
quote: Smyth: Earned 1 star in 2017, advanced to 2 stars in 2018-2019, then achieved 3-star status in 2023. Alinea: Maintained 3 stars from 2011-2023, recently downgraded to 2 stars in 2025

claim: Smyth listed in La Liste's Top 1000 Restaurants and North America's 50 Best; The Loyalist is a casual companion restaurant in the same building
quote: Featured in La Liste Top 1000 Restaurants, North America's 50 Best Restaurants 2026

claim: Smyth reservations are through Tock; the restaurant sells out quickly on release dates
Alinea offers three distinct room experiences (Kitchen Table, Gallery, Salon); reservations via Tock; located in Lincoln Park
quote: The Kitchen Table, The Gallery, The Salon

claim: Alinea's three room experiences: Salon $365, Gallery $435, Kitchen Table $495; demoted from 3★ to 2★ in 2025 for inconsistent execution
quote: Alinea continues to offer its three distinct dining experiences - Salon ($365), Gallery ($435), and Kitchen Table ($495) per person

claim: Ever is open Tue–Sat for dinner; adjacent cocktail bar 'After' available pre/post dinner; private dining room for up to 12 guests
Ever's 8–10 course tasting menu lasts approximately 2 to 2.5 hours; focuses on proteins from land and sea, seasonal vegetables, fruits, grains, seeds
quote: proteins from the land and sea, and seasonal vegetables complemented with fruits, grains, seeds and nuts... typically lasts 2 to 2 1/2 hours

claim: Kasama tasting menu $325/person; pairings $195 (alcohol) or $95 (non-alcoholic); dinner Thu–Sun only; daytime café/bakery Wed–Sun 9am–3pm; 2023 James Beard Award winner; North America's 50 Best 2025
quote: $325 with optional beverage pairings at $195 or non-alcoholic at $95. Dinner: Thursday through Sunday (reservation-only fine dining)

claim: Oriole dining room $325/person (parties of 1–6); Kitchen Table $375/person (parties of 1–4); bookings via Tock on a 90-day rolling calendar
quote: The dining room reservation costs $325 per person for parties of 1 to 6, while the kitchen table experience is $375 per person for parties of 1 to 4. Bookings may be made up to 90 calendar days in advance.

claim: Chef Noah Sandoval received the James Beard Foundation Best Chef: Great Lakes award in 2025
quote: Chef Sandoval received the James Beard Foundation's Best Chef (Great Lakes) award in 2025

claim: Amy Cordell (Ever front-of-house) won the 2025 Michelin Service Award; Alinea demoted from 3★ to 2★; Kasama promoted to 2★ at the November 2025 ceremony
quote: Amy Cordell was given a special recognition, the service award, for her management of hospitality and the front of house at two-starred Ever

claim: Smyth dining room features warm wooden tones, open kitchen, and an intentionally unpretentious atmosphere; kitchen takes creative risks with unusual ingredient pairings
quote: The dining space features warm wooden tones with simple tables and chairs and an open kitchen. The atmosphere intentionally avoids pretension

claim: Oriole is one of Chicago's hardest restaurants to book; typically no weekend seating available for 4+ weeks in advance
quote: only one late-night weekday table was available for the current week, with no weekend seating for at least a month out
